director_core: Preserve and strengthen the user's intended story, feeling and viewer experience.
Use storyboard candidates as visual hypotheses when the intent is not fully verbalized.
Prefer one coherent directing grammar per candidate instead of averaging every available reference.
Keep global identity, space, causality and emotional continuity strong while allowing shot grammar to vary.
Choose production routes from capabilities verified for the active executor and engine.

modes.creative_intent: Observe natural behavior while keeping the place and action readable.
Make the recording setup and body language part of the story.
Move closer only when expression and emotional change carry the scene.
Use a meaningful object and purposeful cuts to reveal the character and situation.
Let the environment establish mood and story information before the character takes focus.
Create a clear visual rhythm with purposeful scale changes and cuts.

when_to_use: Place, weather or spatial context materially shapes the episode.
when_not_to_use: The environment has no narrative or emotional role.
do_not_copy: a reference episode's literal room, weather or shot order
skills.guidance: Establish a meaningful place before or while revealing the character; make the environment causally relevant.

when_to_use: A self-recorded scene should show deliberate camera placement and body language.
when_not_to_use: Urgency or intimacy specifically requires a handheld camera.
do_not_copy: the same shelf, room or entrance action every time
skills.guidance: Make camera support explicit and let the character enter, check or settle into the recorded frame.

when_to_use: Expression or immediate personal presence is the intended hook.
when_not_to_use: A close view would hide story-critical space or body language.
skills.guidance: Use closeness deliberately and reveal enough context for the expression to have meaning.

when_to_use: A prop summarizes the episode, creates curiosity or causes the next action.
when_not_to_use: The object is decorative and has no relationship to what follows.
skills.guidance: Open on a meaningful object, then connect it causally to the character and episode.

when_to_use: Purposeful behavior can reveal character faster than exposition.
when_not_to_use: Added motion would be empty fidgeting.
do_not_copy: random movement added only for activity
skills.guidance: Begin with one purposeful action whose change or result advances the scene.

when_to_use: Dialogue or observation needs physical behavior that reveals character or space.
when_not_to_use: The action competes with the intended emotional hold.
skills.guidance: Give the character one meaningful action before or during speech, with a readable start and result.

when_to_use: Spatial continuity, observation or natural performance is the main appeal.
when_not_to_use: The clip would require too many unrelated sequential actions.
do_not_copy: a fixed duration or camera move
skills.guidance: Keep one feasible action path continuous and ensure something meaningful changes inside the frame.

when_to_use: Controlled reveals, compression or object details benefit from separate shots.
when_not_to_use: Cuts would fragment an emotionally continuous performance.
skills.guidance: Use cuts only when each changes information, emphasis or rhythm; preserve state across intended continuity.

when_to_use: The viewer should understand place before moving emotionally closer.
when_not_to_use: The scene requires immediate intimate urgency.
skills.guidance: Establish spatial context, then approach the character as emotional information becomes important.

when_to_use: A subtle emotional change must remain visible long enough to register.
when_not_to_use: The beat has no internal change or narrative importance.
do_not_copy: melodramatic expression or arbitrary slow motion
skills.guidance: Hold attention on a subtle change, state what can move, and define how the beat exits.

when_to_use: Separate shots or clips must feel like one coherent event.
when_not_to_use: Discontinuity is deliberately used for montage, comedy or time compression.
skills.guidance: Declare the state entering and leaving each dependent shot, including position, orientation, props and environment changes.
